description:
Engineering · Full-time · On-site, San Francisco · Salary: $180K - $250K + meaningful ownership of equity


ABOUT ERAGON

Eragon is an Applied AI lab building an AI platform that powers proactive agents for sovereign enterprises. We're working on memory, model routing, continual learning, and product experience that make agents useful, reliable, and governable in real-world settings.

We've raised more than $26 million in seed funding from investors including Khosla Ventures, a16z, Soma Capital, and Long Journey Ventures. We work with customers including Deel, Slash, Prodware, and Corgi to power their AI-native workflows.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Member of Technical Staff on Product, you'll own what Eragon builds and why—turning customer needs, technical capabilities, and research insights into products people rely on.

The people who do well here are AI-native product thinkers: close to customers, close to engineers, and opinionated about how agents should work for people. You'll have real ownership early and work across the whole agent experience.


IDEALLY, YOU'D HAVE

Experience from one of these areas:

 1. Product managers who've shipped AI products and understand how LLMs change product design

 2. Engineers or designers who moved into product and want to own its direction

 3. Founders or early-startup operators who've built a product from zero to one


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Find the Right Problems: Lead discovery with customers and internal teams to find the highest-value workflows

 - Set Direction: Define requirements and priorities, balancing user value, technical feasibility, and business impact

 - Build with the Team: Partner with engineering and design to prototype, launch, and improve the product

 - Measure Quality: Use customer feedback, product data, and eval results to guide iteration

 - Keep Everyone Aligned: Communicate product decisions clearly from early exploration through delivery


REQUIREMENTS

Must haves

 - AI Product Experience: Has shipped AI products as a PM or builder and understands how AI changes product design and user workflows

 - Product Judgment: Turns ambiguous problems into focused, testable plans

 - Technical Fluency: Works closely with engineers and designers and makes sound tradeoffs

 - User Focus: Iterative, user-centered approach to discovery, prototyping, and measuring outcomes

 - Communication: Clear in writing and in person; keeps teams aligned in a fast-moving environment

Nice to haves

 - Experience with agent systems, evals, or enterprise software

 - Comfort prototyping on your own, in code or no-code tools

Equal opportunity: Eragon is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome people of all backgrounds and identities and want everyone here to do their best work as themselves.

Accommodations: If you need support or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, let us know and we'll be glad to help.
